title: 3.5 Boss: Order-Statistic Heist
concept: Order-statistic AVL tree (k-th most valuable / largest, subtree size invariant)
objective: Use subtree size badges (sz) to steal the k-th MOST VALUABLE (k-th largest) treasure in O(log n) while the vault validates sz invariants after rotations!
controls: Click the k-th largest (most valuable) node using subtree size (sz) badges
start_status: Challenge 1/2: Click the 3rd MOST VALUABLE (3rd-largest, k=3) treasure using subtree sizes (sz)!
hints: For the k-th most valuable (largest) key, check the RIGHT child's sz badge: if k <= rightSize go right; if k == rightSize + 1 this room is the answer; otherwise subtract (rightSize + 1) and go left.
After a rotation updates subtree sizes, apply the same rightSize comparison rule at each step.
